description: Audit whether the tenant's data can power each product capability — the answer to 'why are my recommendations empty?'. Returns, per capability (forecast_foundation, reorder_recommendations, demand_forecasting, days_of_supply, inventory_health), a ready/partial/not_ready status derived from its REQUIRED data gates, plus every gate's coverage numbers (e.g. items with a confident demand signal / supplier terms / costs / stock on hand, months of sales history) and the specific tool that closes each gap. A required coverage gate is a minimum: it is ready once anything is covered, because how much of a catalog needs covering depends on the business. Its `remaining` count is what is still uncovered — offer that as an optional improvement, never as a blocker. Re-run it after seeding to verify gates went green. Coverage confines to a client-pinned credential's client; an unpinned 3PL operator can pass clientId.

clientId.description: Optional client id for a 3PL operator view. Client-pinned credentials omit it.
